high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "yasminazaytoun." The post was taken in Beirut, Lebanon, as indicated in the location tag. The photo shows a person taking a mirror selfie in an elevator. The individual is wearing a white oversized T-shirt with a large pink graphic of a teddy bear on it. They are also wearing light blue shorts. The person is holding a blue smartphone in their right hand, which they are using to take the selfie. The background consists of the metallic elevator doors, reflecting the person's image.
